Why The Braces Point

Dentistry that feels nothing like dentistry

Patients come to us nervous and leave wondering what they were worried about. Four things make that happen, visit after visit.

Painless root canal expertise

Our most-reviewed treatment. Rotary endodontics, profound local anaesthesia and a gentle hand mean most root canals finish in a single sitting — without the pain people fear.

Transparent pricing, always

You see the full cost before treatment begins — itemised, in writing, with options at different budgets. No surprise additions halfway through a procedure. Ever.

Easy payment options on treatments

Implants, aligners and smile makeovers shouldn't wait for a bonus. Split your treatment cost into easy monthly instalments at 0% interest, approved in minutes at the clinic.

5.0-star patient trust

A perfect 5.0 rating across 1046+ Google reviews — built on honest advice, on-time appointments and results that last. We recommend only what your teeth actually need.

Questions, Answered

Everything patients ask us first

Yes — and it's the treatment our patients review most. With modern rotary instruments and a careful anaesthesia protocol, the infected tooth is fully numb before we begin. Most patients tell us the appointment hurt less than the toothache that brought them in, and most root canals here finish in a single sitting.

Your first consultation is just ₹1000. It includes a complete oral examination and a written treatment plan with exact prices for every option — so you can decide calmly, with no obligation to start treatment the same day.

Yes — Easy payment options is available on implants, aligners, braces, smile design and most treatments above ₹10,000. Approval takes a few minutes at the clinic, and your treatment starts right away while you pay monthly at zero interest.

Always. After your examination, you receive an itemised written estimate covering the complete treatment. The price you're quoted is the price you pay — if anything unexpected appears mid-treatment, we discuss it with you before proceeding.

We love treating kids. Children's dentistry here includes gentle check-ups, fluoride applications, sealants and fillings — all at an unhurried pace, with parents welcome in the room. First visits are kept short and fun so children build a healthy habit for life.
